kai (partnerships): Quick sync 1 - ACME SI wants to push a joint marketplace entry + announcement mid-Apr. We need to lock the security deliverables and upload flow.
lee (security): High level: SOC2 PDF, pen-test executive summary, questionnaire answers (completed), and sample redacted artifacts. Also require a machine-readable manifest (sha256) for every file.
tori (infra): We should standardize filenames and paths. Proposal: s3://partners/redwood-acme/{artifact-type}/{YYYYMMDD}/{filename}.zip for portal. Public bundle goes to s3://marketplace-assets/redwood-acme/{version}/public.zip.
ivan (acme-si): ACME can post artifacts to the partners path by Apr 6. We prefer presigned URLs for distribution and a 21-day expiry for portal access. Is 21d OK?
lee (security): Security prefers 30d but will accept 21d if legal signs off. Also require that presigned links are scoped to the partner group and that we store an access log for audit.
maya (legal): 21d acceptable. We'll need the attestation.txt inside the public bundle: one short line stating "No customer PII or Redwood internal data included; both parties performed redaction." I'll upload our approved wording by EOD.
kai (partnerships): Good. On redaction: ACME does initial redaction, Redwood will perform a final scrub pass focusing on internal hostnames, internal ticket IDs, and customer emails. Lee, you'll take lead?
lee (security): I'll take the final scrub. Please provide a checklist for what qualifies as PII or internal IP. Sample rules: email regex, hostname patterns (*.redwood.internal), ticket IDs (RDW-\d+).
tori (infra): For the evidence manifest, let's use a JSONL file where each line is "filename sha256 owner size-bytes". Example: `evidence-manifest.jsonl` entry: `{"file":"soc2-2025-acme.pdf","sha256":"<hex>","owner":"acme","size":123456}`. We'll store signed manifest as `evidence-manifest.jsonl.sig` if partner signs.
ivan (acme-si): ACME can provide a PGP-signed manifest. We'll include key id and signature file.
lee (security): If partner signs, infra should verify signature on upload. Tori, can you add a verification job in the staging pipeline?
tori (infra): Yep, I can add a CI step to verify signatures and checksums. Pipeline will reject artifacts that fail verification and notify the upload channel.
kai (partnerships): Timeline proposal: artifacts uploaded by Apr 6 -> Redwood scrub Apr 7 -> staging bundle built Apr 8 -> internal QA + smoke tests Apr 9 -> public bundle ready Apr 10 -> announce Apr 13. Go/no-go meeting Apr 10 16:00 UTC.
maya (legal): Confirm no NDA clauses prevent us from including redacted screenshots. If ACME needs further redactions, we need to see redaction requests by Apr 6.
ivan (acme-si): We'll surface any contract redaction asks with the initial upload.
lee (security): Also check scope alignment: pen test must cover the same surfaces as the marketplace offering (API endpoints, model variant list). If there are scope gaps, we'll need compensating controls documented.
kai (partnerships): Action list: @ivan upload artifacts by Apr 6; @lee perform Redwood redaction Apr 7; @tori add signature/checksum verification to staging and produce presigned portal URLs Apr 8; @maya final attestation language and legal signoff by Apr 6. I'll draft the 2-line security blurb for press.
deploybot: Reminder set: "Joint marketplace publish go/no-go" 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z. Attendees: kai, lee, tori, maya, ivan.
lee (security): One more ask: include an "allowed-models.txt" listing model ids + exact versions that will be exposed via the marketplace listing. Put it in both bundles.
tori (infra): We'll auto-generate allowed-models.txt from release metadata once the product tag is final. Ping me when product team confirms tag.
ivan (acme-si): ACME will include cert of remediation: small doc listing vulnerabilities fixed after pen test with ticket links (redacted). Is linking to internal tickets OK if redacted?
maya (legal): Links to internal tickets must not leak PII or internal hostnames. Replace with redacted ticket identifiers and short remediation descriptions.
lee (security): Agree. For auditability, include CVE ids where applicable and a short remediation note.
kai (partnerships): Final thing: can we produce an "evidence-index.csv" with columns: filename, sha256, owner, public_flag (yes/no), presign_expiry. That helps partners and marketplace reviewers.
tori (infra): I'll emit evidence-index.csv at staging time and include presigned links. Public bundle will have the same CSV but with public_flag set and no presigned URLs.
ivan (acme-si): ACME requests that we also provide a contact for post-publish security questions: ivan-security@acme.example and lee@redwood.com.
lee (security): OK, we'll confirm that in the announcement draft.
kai (partnerships): Perfect. I'll send a short checklist doc in this channel tomorrow morning and create the calendar invite for Apr 10 go-no-go. Thanks :white_check_mark:
